prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
Specialized AI visibility and tracking tools—such as Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker, Semrush AI Search Visibility Checker, and dedicated platforms like Frizerly or Datawise—are the best services to systematically check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business. Reddit·r/localseo +2
Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker: Tracks brand and link mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Grok, showing frequently mentioned topics and cited pages.
Semrush AI Search Visibility Checker: Analyzes your domain's visibility in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, identifying top competitors and popular prompt opportunities.
Frizerly & Datawise: Dedicated AI tracking platforms built to monitor brand recommendations, citations, and visibility metrics specifically across conversational search engines. YouTube·Nico | AI Ranking +1
The Free, Manual Alternative
You can also run manual audits without paid software:
Open ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity.
Type localized queries your customers use, such as "What is the best [your service/product] in [your city/neighborhood]?"
Test direct brand queries (e.g., "Who is [Your Business Name]?") to check foundational brand awareness inside the model's training data and real-time index. Instagram·Momentum 360° +2
What is your industry or specific service?
Are you targeting local customers in a specific city or an online audience?
